name: Francisco Assis - Après le § 83 - Am 46
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 83a. Stresses that the EU-Israel Association Agreement is, according to Article 2 thereof, based on the fulfilment of human rights obligations and emphasises these as a guiding principle; notes that Israel stands accused of genocide and calls, therefore, for the immediate termination of the EU-Israel Association Agreement;
